_about: Words Edge TTS (bn-BD-NabanitaNeural) says wrongly, and the spelling Edge is given instead. Only the text sent to Edge changes; the cards, questions and site keep the normal spelling. Whole words only: কোন changes, কোনটা and কোনো do not (add them as their own entries if Edge gets them wrong). 'say' is what Edge gets; an empty 'say' switches the entry off. 'try' lists spellings to compare with: python3 scripts/edge_backup.py --test-respell. After changing 'say', re-record with --redo-respell (never touches Gemini recordings).

কোন.problem: Edge often adds a trailing o (kono); it should be kon
কোন.tested: 2026-11-25: Tim — both কোন্ and কোন্‌ fix it; using কোন্

যেন.problem: needs a trailing o (jeno); Edge says jen

কেন.problem: often needs a trailing o (keno); Edge says ken
কেন.tested: 2026-11-25: Tim heard no difference between কেন and কেনো in 'বোতাম লাগানোর আগে সুতায় গিঁট দেন কেন?', so it is switched off (empty 'say'). If a nurturer reports a কেন that Edge says as 'ken', test another spelling here.
